conclusions: The currentBASE already covers exposed performance-relevant nativeLow/Off controls. No missing active nativeparticlequality or anisotropy slider was found.

Strongest remaining normal-setting candidates on the observed DX11 UI are lower render scale, matched-scale Stretch/FSR1/FSR2, native FXAA clarity comparison and native Anti-Lag On/Off throughput-versus-latency test. FSR3 is present in shipped generic XML but absent from the observed DX11 selector, so remains experimental and is not a default recommendation.
NativeShadowquality0 isLow. The full lower-levelcallback behavior is not published in available sources; do not equate it with globalr_shadows0.
A restrainedrelease shadowmap-scale0.5 experiment is plausible but needs currentreadback+shadowcue+performance validation. It is not a defaultrecommendation.
Ragdoll/blood/morph/particlebound controls are not automatically visually safe because they lackcheatflags. Doormanindicator counterevidence blocks a recommendedragdoll reduction.

31manual-key removal is justified for restoring source-backed nativeconfiguration and compatibility, not as proof ofFPSgain. Some prior hidden overrides may have saved renderwork if they were actually honored.
Hardwarebucket policy is now source-backed; actual CPU/GPU/memory-tier sideeffects still are not. Preserving them for thesecomparisonprofiles prevents thatunknown from confounding results.
No measuredwinner or thousandfoldgain can be claimed. Game-runtime values and matched representative fights/replays remain required.
